A QUICK STREET LESSON

KNOW YOUR MOVES.

Move in any laneWASD / ARROWS
RunSHIFT + MOVE
Punch / swing weaponJ / Z
Kick / throw weaponK / X
Jump / jump kickSPACE / SPACE + K
Guard / timed parryHOLD L / C
Pick up / enter shopE
Spin attack, at full gritQ
Three punches make a combo. Attack in the same lane as your target. Hold an attack button to keep fighting. Block just before a hit to parry. Pick up bats, bins, or fallen foes. Jump over Big Bell's ground wave.

Collect coins. Visit the food and book shops after a fight. Your game saves after each cleared fight and purchase.

TOUCH: Use the stick and action buttons. Push the stick fully to run.
GAMEPAD: Left stick · X punch · B kick · A jump · LB guard · Y use · RB grit · Start pause.
Esc: pause · M: sound · F: full screen. No network is needed.
